_comment: Single source of truth for launch facts. Pages and docs read from here instead of hard-coding a chain, a venue, an address or a status. Values still written as {{PLACEHOLDER}} are not decided: the site renders them as 'to be announced' (app/lib/launch.ts) and never prints the placeholder. When a value is final, replace it here, rebuild, and the whole site follows.
